units.source_text: “更有一种女子，看见丈夫略把爱情移向他人，便怀恨在心，公然和丈夫离居，这也是下愚之策吧。

en.t: There is another kind of woman who, when she sees her husband's affection turn even slightly toward someone else, bears a grudge and openly lives apart from him; surely that too is a very foolish course.

units.source_text: 男子即使稍稍移爱他人，但回想新相知时的热爱，还能眷恋旧情。

en.t: Even if a man shifts his love a little toward another, when he recalls the passion of their first acquaintance, he can still feel attachment to the old bond.

units.source_text: 此心可能使夫妇重新言归于好；如今怀恨离居，此心便起动摇，终于消失，从此情缘断绝了。

en.t: That feeling may allow husband and wife to make peace again; but if she now separates from him in resentment, that feeling will waver, finally disappear, and from then on their bond will be severed.

units.source_text: 总之，无论何事，总宜沉着应付：丈夫方面倘有可怨之事，宜向他暗示我已知道；

en.t: In short, whatever happens, one should always respond calmly: if there is something blameworthy on the husband's side, it is best to hint to him that I already know.

units.source_text: 即使有可恨之事，亦应在言语中隐约表示而勿伤感情。

en.t: Even if there is something hateful, she should suggest it indirectly in her words without wounding his feelings.

units.source_text: 这样，丈夫对她的爱情便可挽回过来。

en.t: In this way, her husband's love for her can be won back.

units.source_text: 在多数情况之下，男子的负心是全靠女子的态度来治疗的。

en.t: In most cases, a man's faithlessness is cured entirely by the woman's attitude.

units.source_text: 然而女子如果全不介意，听其放恣，虽然丈夫可以自由自在而感谢妻子的宽大，但女子取这态度，亦不免过于轻率吧。

en.t: However, if the woman does not mind at all and lets him indulge himself, then although the husband may enjoy his freedom and be grateful for his wife's tolerance, for the woman to take such an attitude is still rather too careless.

units.source_text: 那时这男子就像不系之舟，随波逐流，漫无归宿，才真是危险的。

en.t: At that point the man is like an untethered boat, drifting with the waves and having no place to return to; that is what is truly dangerous.
Would you say this is so, or not?
